Figure 1: Overview of the SSL representation. A text-heavy skill artifact is converted by a normalizer into three layers: a scheduling record for invocation-level signals, a structural graph of execution scenes, and a logical graph of atomic actions and resource-use evidence. The structured view remains paired with the original source document and supports downstream tasks such as Skill Discovery and Risk Assessment.
